subject.title: Migrate Fact Rail into a feature-local boundary

question: Should this repository make a documented exception for committed GrillTrack lifecycle records, or should this PR remove those generated records before merge?
rationale: The PR's retained records conflict with the checked-in policy that generated reports and traces stay ignored, and the contributor describes those records as intentional durable history.

options.title: Remove generated records
options.body: Retain the source migration and immutable external proof links, but remove the added GrillTrack archive, ledger, event, and generated review-report files.

options.title: Document an exception
options.body: Explicitly amend repository policy to allow the narrowly defined GrillTrack lifecycle records that this PR adds.

recommendation.title: Remove generated records
recommendation.body: Retain the source migration and immutable external proof links, but remove the added GrillTrack archive, ledger, event, and generated review-report files.

likelyOwner.reason: The agent contract identifies Bobby as the merge-approval authority and supplies the policy requiring interpretation.
